item.title: Houthis attack Saudi capital as Trump weighs strikes
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi forces launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia and promised further strikes as Trump considers U.S. action on the emerging front.

item.title: Dancing With the Stars eliminates couple on Super Bowl Night
item.description: ABC News' Ginger Zee went behind the scenes as stars and their pro partners danced to songs from past Super Bowl halftime shows.

item.title: Doctor on Pope Leo's lung cancer diagnosis: nonsmokers can get lung cancer
item.description: The Vatican says Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer but is recovering as expected from surgery to remove a nodular lesion.

item.title: New search launched for Amelia Earhart's missing plane
item.description: Earhart and navigator Fred Noonan vanished nearly 90 years ago as she sought to become the first woman to fly around the world.
